summary: Legal registration required for commercial offices, retail shops, and service establishments employing workers.

steps.title: Register on state labour portal
steps.description: Create profile on state unified labour/single-window clearance portal with business details.

steps.title: Fill application form
steps.description: Enter establishment name, full postal address, category of business, number of male/female employees, and working hours.
documents_needed: Rent agreement or property tax receipt

steps.title: Upload identity and address proofs
steps.description: Attach photo of proprietor with shop signboard displaying name clearly in regional language & English.

steps.title: Pay statutory registration fees
steps.description: Submit fee calculated based on employee bracket via integrated portal gateway.

steps.title: Download digital certificate
steps.description: Receive digitally signed Shops & Establishment Certificate without physical inspection for low-risk units.
